_comment: Expected DE-301 fill for case.example.json. Demonstrates the multi-party formal probate petition fill. Key validator-relevant patterns: applicant_signature_name must match applicant_full_legal_name (relaxed); notary_appearer_name must match applicant_full_legal_name (relaxed); applicant_signature_date must follow date_of_death.
_pipeline_walkthrough: case_constant fields (3): populated from case_dict — county_probate_court, docket_no, estate_of_decedent
party_attr/applicant (4): populated from applicant_record — note applicant_address_email_phone is a COMPOSITE field, format as 'address / phone / email'
party_attr/appointee (1): person_whose_appointment_is_sought = appointee_record.appointee (here, same as applicant)
party_attr/notary (3): populated from notary_record + appearance event
narrative_derived dates (2): date_of_death + applicant_signature_date — must satisfy date_order(date_of_death, >) on signature
legal_choice yes/no (3): domiciled_in_county, will_presented_for_probate, nominated_as_pr_in_will — all yes here
signature (3): applicant_signature_name (printed name), notary_date, special_admin_acceptance_signature (null since no special admin)

fields.applicant_address_email_phone: 33 Pleasant Hill Road, Bath, ME 04530 / (207) 555-0118 / mlch@example.com
fields.will_details: Will dated 2018-09-14, two-page typed, witnessed by Lawrence Reed and Susan Maddox. No codicils.

equals_field(applicant_full_legal_name,: applicant_signature_name vs applicant_full_legal_name: both 'Margaret L. Crawford-Hines' → passes
notary_appearer_name vs applicant_full_legal_name: both 'Margaret L. Crawford-Hines' → passes
_validator_expectations.populate_from_case_dict: county_probate_court / docket_no / estate_of_decedent match case_dict → no drift warnings
_validator_expectations.data_type checks: phone, email, bar_number, address all valid per their data_type regexes
_validator_expectations.value_in(yes, no): (if encoded on the 3 legal_choice booleans) all values are 'yes' → would pass

_what_could_fail.applicant_signature_name drift: If LLM wrote 'Margaret Crawford-Hines' (dropping middle initial), equals_field(relaxed) still passes (it strips punctuation + case but not the initial). Strict mode would fail.
_what_could_fail.notary_appearer_name vs applicant: If applicant changed names since the will was executed (e.g. signing as 'Margaret L. Crawford' instead of 'Margaret L. Crawford-Hines'), notary check catches it.
_what_could_fail.venue inconsistency: If domiciled_in_county=yes but venue_basis_if_not_domiciled is non-empty, that's contradictory — validator would not catch this directly; encode as required_when or hand review.
_what_could_fail.special_admin accidental fill: If LLM filled special_admin_acceptance_date despite special_admin_requested=false, validator's writable_when (if encoded) would flag not_writable.
